SDK_host_interface.use: Only non-executable static host register facts. Program writes seen within these functions are excluded, not translated into source arrays.

sources.reference_limit: The current demo_aiot file contains LP5 parameters; demo_aiot-bak contains the LP4 profile matching clock/type/geometry and selected historical MR observations. It is a reference, not proof that every field exactly equals the prior boot's mutable runtime parameter block.

address_name_policy: Physical addresses below come from this SoC's host MMIO code. Logical names are separately corroborated in SiMa source comments. No global ARC/host address alias is asserted and no SiMa register preset is imported.

parameter_facts.required_decisions: para2 bit12 is set; tpr13 bit6 is set and bit2 is clear; (tpr3>>16)&0xf is1 in LP4 reference. Type9 in SDK dram_type means LP5, not the PHY revision.

strict_exclusions: C_initPhyConfig includes generated PIE/shadow instruction writes at0x0aa801e2 and nearby addresses. The instruction region0x1b4..0x22c of that host function is excluded from implementation and presets in this audit.
Other PIE control/program registers at0x0aa8010c and0x0aa80242 are not treated as analog initialization simply because the host writes them.
PsLoop also contains ACSM/program/shadow descriptors. Only named MASTER PLL/DFI/ZCal facts listed here are retained; descriptor values and generation are excluded.
No vendor IMEM/PIE contents, training result DMEM, delay sweeps or sequencer algorithm is translated into C or an array.
next_source_work: Once outer ownership and internal access are established, observe LP5Mode, DfiMode and selected static CSRs in a fixed guarded SRAM probe.

Author source configuration from these individually reviewed non-executable register contracts, recording unknown field semantics as opaque board controls and checking each write/readback. Keep reset-affecting MemResetL separate.
Use small staged electrical changes and actual timer/readback evidence. A preset match is not a calibration pass.
Implement independent ZCal start/result and LP4 command/measurement operations with the separate host-training work; do not substitute copied sequencer programs.
